# Cliffco, Inc. — Alaska Mortgage Lender

> Cliffco, Inc. (Corporate NMLS #65328) is an independent mortgage lender founded in 1989, licensed by the Alaska Division of Banking and Securities (AK65328, AK65328-1). This site serves Alaska borrowers only. Corporate office: 70 Charles Lindbergh Blvd, Suite 200, Uniondale, NY 11553. Phone: (516) 408-7300.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cliffcoinc.com/): Alaska mortgage lending overview
- [About](https://cliffcoinc.com/about/): Company history, values, and leadership
- [Loan Programs](https://cliffcoinc.com/loan-programs/): VA, conventional, FHA, Non-QM, bank statement, DSCR, reverse, renovation, refinancing
- [Contact](https://cliffcoinc.com/contact/): Reach a licensed loan officer

## Key facts

- Legal name: Cliffco, Inc.
- Corporate NMLS: #65328 (verify at www.nmlsconsumeraccess.org)
- Alaska license: AK65328, AK65328-1 (AK Division of Banking and Securities)
- Founded: 1989
- President: Christopher Clifford, NMLS #65234
- Lending model: fully remote across Alaska; borrowers work directly with a licensed loan officer
- Specialties: VA loans, self-employed and seasonal-income borrowers (bank statement, 1099, asset-based qualification), DSCR investor loans, second-chance lending
- This website serves property and persons located in the state of Alaska only
